info.title: Get Shop LIVE Products Performance List
info.description: Returns sale performance for each product in a shop-related LIVE session from the official account or marketing accounts.

get.summary: Get Shop LIVE Products Performance List
get.description: Returns sale performance for each product in a shop-related LIVE session from the official account or marketing accounts.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
Sort direction.

Available values: ASC, DESC

Default value: DESC

* ASC: ascending

* DESC: descending

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
Field to sort on.
Default: gmv
Available values:
- direct_gmv
- items_sold
- customers
- created_sku_orders
- sku_orders
- main_orders
- product_impressions
- produt_clicks

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency for monetary values. Use USD for US dollars or LOCAL for the local currency where the shop is registered.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

amount.description: Direct GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

direct_gmv.description: The total amount paid for orders of this product directly from the LIVE, including returns and refunds.

items_sold.description: The number of product items sold

customers.description: The total numbers of customers who ordered this product directly from the LIVE, including customers who made returns or refunds.

created_sku_orders.description: The total number of SKU orders created directly from the LIVE for this product.

amount.description: Average price amount in the corresponding currency.

avg_price.description: Average direct GMV per main order. Also known as AOV (main order)

sku_orders.description: The total number of paid SKU orders placed directly from the LIVE for this product.

main_orders.description: Total number of paid main orders placed. Main orders refer to the single purchase transaction a customer makes.

payment_rate.description: Main order paid / Main order created of this product

sales.description: Sales performance for the product in the LIVE session, including average price, orders, customers, GMV, and items sold.

product_impressions.description: Number of product impressions for this product during the LIVE video, including for product lists and product cards

ctr.description: Click-through rate: The number of product clicks for this product from the LIVE video, divided by the number of product impressions for this product from the LIVE video, including product clicks and product impressions for product lists and product cards

add_to_cart_count.description: The number of times viewers add the product to their cart.

sku_order_ctor.description: The percentage of times viewers clicked product links in LIVE streams and placed a direct order.

main_order_ctor.description: Percentage of times viewers who clicked LIVE product links also placed a main order.

watch_gpm.description: The Watch GPM is the average GMV generated from 1,000 views of the LIVE.

gpm.description: GPM data for product traffic, including watch GPM.

produt_clicks.description: The total number of times the product was clicked from this LIVE, including from the product list and product card

traffic.description: Traffic performance for the product in the LIVE session, including add-to-cart, click-to-order, CTR, GPM, product impressions, and product clicks.

products.description: List of products and their sales and traffic performance for the LIVE session.
